newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanrio shares bid-only on rosy forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sanrio shares bid-only on rosy forecast.

text.p: Shares of Sanrio Co Ltd, a leading manufacturer of gift merchandise, were bid-only on Friday morning, cheered by a brighter earnings forecast it announced on Thursday, brokers said.
At 0039 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 927 yen against Thursday's 907 yen.
Brokers said that the shares were reacting to Sanrio's sharp upward revision of its earnings forecast for the current financial half-year to September.
The firm made the revision due to the a boom in sales of its "Hello Kitty" product, which is popular among high-school girls.
On Thursday, Sanrio forecast a parent current profit of 2.8 billion yen for the six months to September 30, against a previous forecast of a 340 million yen loss.
It posted a parent current loss of 62 million yen a year ago.
